title: Swift NGS Part 1 - Swift Rapid NGS Part 4 - SPRI Clean
author: Opentrons
materials: Magnetic beads are added to samples.
Samples are incubated at room temperature.
Plate is placed back on magnetic module.
Low EDTA TE is added to beads, incubate.

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Specify the number of samples, Reverse Transcription Mastermix overage percent (0‑10 %), bead drying time, Opentrons 96‑tip rack 20 µL tip type (filter or non‑filter), P300 multi‑channel GEN2 mount (left or right), and P20 single‑channel GEN2 mount (left or right).

steps.title: Add magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Add the magnetic beads to each sample well.

steps.title: Incubate at room temperature
steps.instruction: Incubate the bead‑mixed samples at room temperature.

steps.title: Pause, remove, seal, spin
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol, remove the plate from the deck, seal it, and spin it down.

steps.title: Place plate on magnetic module
steps.instruction: Return the sealed plate to the deck and place it on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove and discard the supernatant from each well while the beads are held by the magnet.

steps.title: Ethanol wash beads
steps.instruction: Perform two ethanol washes: add ethanol, incubate for 30 seconds, then remove the supernatant; repeat once.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the ethanol addition, 30‑second incubation, and removal.

steps.title: Pause, seal, spin after washes
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol, remove the plate, seal it, and spin it down.

steps.title: Dry beads
steps.instruction: Allow the beads to air‑dry for the specified bead drying time before proceeding.

steps.title: Add Low EDTA TE
steps.instruction: Add Low EDTA TE buffer to the dried beads and incubate (duration not specified).

steps.title: Pause, seal, spin final
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol, remove the plate, seal it, and spin it down.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to PCR plate
steps.instruction: Move the supernatant to columns 5, 6, and 7 of a new PCR plate located in Slot 9.
